found_at: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Giphy_Logo_9.2016.svg (Commons gives its source as GIPHY's Brand Guidelines, support.giphy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360022283772)
edits: removed the dark banner rectangle behind the whole lockup (element 0)
cropped the viewBox to the page mark (pad 0.02)
notes: GIPHY publishes no SVG I could reach: giphy.com and developers.giphy.com serve PNG/GIF/WebP logos only, the brand-guidelines page answers 403, and its own SDK carries the mark only as an Android VectorDrawable. Commons' other file (Giphy-logo.svg) is sourced from worldvectorlogo, so I did not use it. GIPHY's app icon sets this frame on a #121212 square; the source has only a wide banner behind the lockup, so the final is the frame alone: the page interior is the tile colour (dark on dark, white on light). Reviewer: decide whether the white page on light is acceptable.
license: GIPHY brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with GIPHY.
